newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Gree Development plans 249 mln B share IPO.
newsitem.headline: China's Gree Development plans 249 mln B share IPO.

text.p: Air conditioner parts maker Gree Development Co Ltd plans an initial public offering (IPO) of 249 million foreign currency B shares for listing on China's Shenzhen Stock Exchange, a company official said on Thursday.

The Chinese company plans to submit an application for the issue to the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the country's top securities watchdog, by the end of this month, the official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Gree plans to name Shenzhen J&A Securities Co Ltd as the domestic chief underwriter and a securities operation under the Development Bank of Singapore as the global coordinator, he said.

Based in the coastal city of Zhuhai in southern China's Guangdong province, Gree plans to use the proceeds from the offer to upgrade its technology used for the production of air-conditioner compressors.

Zhuhai Gree Group Co will be the largest shareholder in Gree Development after the issue, the official said, adding that Gree Group is also the major shareholder in air-conditioner maker Zhuhai Gree Electrical Appliances Inc.
Gree Development supplies most of its products to Gree Electrical, the official said but declined to give further details of the arrangement.
